items._tools: Tools are held in the weapon hand (equip slot weapon): pick one on the hotbar and it replaces the sword. Held, a hatchet chops wood at yield x the base rate and a pick breaks stone, ore and sulfur at its own; anything else gathers at the base rate. tool: kind, yield, damage (a light hit as a weapon, heavy x1.6), head (its colour on the hand model, linear RGB). items._ranged: Ranged slot (G swaps it with the sword, right mouse aims, left mouse fires). ranged: kind, ammo kind it fires (none = thrown itself), damage (+ the ammo's), speed cm/s, gravity scale, reload s, torpor x the ammo's; mesh / socket / along / face / meshAlong / meshFace / rot / offset place it in the hand: socket is the hero's hand socket (weapon_r, bow_l: the palm's frame), along / face are forward / up / out / back / fingers / grip (through the fist) / palm / backhand / arm (down the forearm) / hands (level, toward the other hand), measured in the body clip named by pose (none = the reference pose); offset is cm in the socket's frame.

items.name: Prism plate

items.name: Glass leg

items.name: Clear membrane

items.name: Venom gland

items.name: Drusy plate

items.name: Glow feather

items.name: Arcane essence

items.name: Attuning chalk

items.name: Saltpetre
items.note: Nitre: the white feathery crust on dry cave walls, scraped off with a pick. Most of what black powder is.

items.note: A resonant crystal fork in a bronze frame. Held to a code lock for 60 s, still, it rings the tumblers loose; the owners' bell rings when you start.

items.name: Vulkarn's soul
items.note: A coal-dark stone, warm to hold, the hammer sigil glowing in it. Forge it at Vulkarn's altar: awaken Cinderbrand, or make the Forge-heart talisman.

items.name: Skaldrith's soul
items.note: A coal-dark stone rimed white, the wyrm sigil glowing in it. Forge it at Skaldrith's altar: awaken Rimefang, or make the Rime-scale talisman.

items.name: Forge-heart
items.note: Vulkarn's soul talisman: your path resource fills 10% faster while you're above 70% health.

items.name: Rime-scale
items.note: Skaldrith's soul talisman: the first blow you take after 10 s unhurt deals 30% less.

items.name: Heron's draught
items.note: A horn of dark mead sealed with wax, a grey heron feather tied on with red thread. 'The heron of forgetting hovers over the ale and steals men's wits' (Havamal). Drink it to forget one path's learning: every point back to spend.

items.name: Champion's mark
items.note: A disc of the war-hall's floor stone with a champion's sigil burned through it. Proof you stood in a war-hall; the Ring on the Crown asks for three.

items.name: Vulkarn's head
items.note: The forge giant's head, still warm in the cracks. Raise it on a monument at home.

items.name: Skaldrith's head
items.note: The frost wyrm's horned head, rime on the teeth. Raise it on a monument at home.

items.name: Storm essence
items.note: lightning path material: sets Lightning as an item's element at crafting

items.name: Thunderstone
items.note: An old polished axe-head the Rodwardens kept as a fallen bolt. A weapon extra: +10% shock buildup

items.name: Voltfang pelt
items.note: Slate fur with white guard hairs that still crackle.

items.name: Thunderhorn horn
items.note: Amber horn, copper-green at the tip from licking ore.

items.name: Stormkite feather
items.note: Long slate flight feathers: fletching.

items.name: Raiju pelt
items.note: Charcoal fur with pale ferns burned through the skin side.

items.name: Storm claw
items.note: A Raiju's black claw, 8 cm, faintly warm.

items.name: Galeback hair
items.note: Long frosted hair from a Galeback's skirt: rope and felt.

items.name: Copper scale
items.note: A Rodcrest's crest scale.

items.name: Charged wool
items.note: Puffram wool sheared in a storm, still standing out with static. A Stormweave extra.

items.name: Kharvox feather
items.note: A moulted primary of the storm roc, copper-tipped. A Stormweave extra.

items.name: Storm plume
items.note: Torn from Kharvox's wing when it broke.

items.name: Cracked bell bronze
items.note: From the Bellwether's bell. A weapon extra: +15% stamina damage on blocked hits.

items.name: Kite tailfeathers
items.note: Galvara's fork feathers: fletched arrows fly 10% faster.

items.name: Coil plate
items.note: Coilback's copper-crusted plate. An armour extra: +10% lightning resistance.

items.name: Stormheart
items.note: Kharvox boss part: every fifth hit chains to a second enemy within 6 m for 40% of the hit

items.name: Scarred Stormheart
items.note: Kharvox boss part from its hidden third phase: every fifth hit chains to a second enemy within 6 m for 50% of the hit

items.name: Crown Plume of Kharvox
items.note: Kharvox's first-kill trophy: mount it at home, or make it into its talisman at the armorer.

items.name: Crown Plume talisman
items.note: Wildbrands charge 15% faster

items.name: Grounding salve
items.note: Copper scale, pine resin and rock salt worked into fat: for 10 minutes a strike won't stun you and does half damage

items.name: Shock-resist potion
items.note: Gentian, stormglass and slime: shock builds at half for 10 minutes

items.name: Stormglass arrow
items.note: a fulgurite head on a kite-feather shaft: +25 shock per hit, passes through one target

items.name: Rodwarden spear
items.note: a copper rod drawn to a leaf-blade, a thunderstone in its butt: Lightning without storm essence

items.name: Rock salt
items.note: Pink halite from the sea cave: salt for meat and salves.

items.name: Iron axe
items.note: a climber's axe, still sharp

items.name: Keeper's tally
items.note: A stick notched once for every strike on the Bell Rod. There are thousands of notches.

items.name: Torc of the given
items.note: A small copper torc, the size of a child's neck, from the cracks of the Feeding Stones.

items.name: Struck one's torc
items.note: Melted into the floor of the top cell, at the heart of the burn. Whoever wore it was holy, after.

items.name: Rod through a rib
items.note: A Rodwarden rod, driven through a leech-drake's rib into the stone of the gut. The rib is burnt black.

items.name: Greywood
items.note: Silver-grey timber from the Withered Forest's dead pines. It never rots: the Hollow bastion's wood, bow staves, spear shafts.

items.name: Grey salt
items.note: Raked from the Grey Strand's pans: salts food, and goes into anchor salt.

items.name: Void essence
items.note: A bead of nothing that weighs too much for its size. The Void path's material.

items.name: Mote gel
items.note: A Driftmote's bell-jelly, faintly violet. Alchemy.

items.name: Hollowfang hide
items.note: Hairless grey-black hide, tight as a drum.

items.name: Riftmaw tooth
items.note: A hooked tooth of black glass from a Riftmaw's ring.

items.name: Nullwing bone
items.note: A hollow wing bone, light and springy: bow limbs.

items.name: Nullwing membrane
items.note: Torn wing skin. Light shows wrong through the holes.

items.name: Hush finger bone
items.note: The long tapping finger of a Hush, a forearm's length of bone.

items.name: Hush ear membrane
items.note: Veined pink-grey skin from a Hush's ear fan.

items.name: Gnawer incisor
items.note: An orange chisel tooth: an arrowhead that bites through hide.

items.name: Riftback plate
items.note: A shell plate edged with voidglass: heavy shield plate.

items.name: Voidstrider filament
items.note: A black mane filament that still drifts upward. Bowstrings.

items.name: Anchor salt
items.note: Eat a pinch: for 5 minutes rifts drain you half as fast (it stacks with a nullward or Hollowplate).

items.name: Anchor salt bag
items.note: Thrown (about 15 m): the salt bursts in a 3 m cloud that closes a brood rift, takes 300 off a rift heart, or holds a crumbling island piece solid for 10 s.

items.name: Throwing stone
items.note: A fist-sized stone. Throw it ahead: in a rift zone it floats; on hollow crust it cracks through and shows the drop.

items.name: Curse-resist draught
items.note: Ashen grain steeped with a voidglass splinter: curse builds at half for 10 minutes.

items.name: Gnawer-tooth arrow
items.note: A Gnawer incisor on a greywood shaft: +20% damage against hide

items.name: Gnashblade
items.note: A serrated blade toothed with Riftmaw glass: always void, and charged heavies break stance 10% harder.

items.name: Hushfinger spear
items.note: A Hush's finger bone on a greywood shaft: 40 cm more reach than steel, and its thrust whistles (anything listening hears it).

items.name: Nullwing bow
items.note: Nullwing bone limbs on greywood, strung with Voidstrider filament: arrows fly 10% faster.

items.name: Voidglass dagger
items.note: A knapped voidglass blade: backstabs +10%; glass, so it wears fast.

items.name: Beacon lantern
items.note: A voidglass lens in bronze: 14 m of light from a tallow (the widest a lantern throws); corruption builds at half while it burns.

items.name: Unfinished row
items.note: Twelve graves dug in a straight row, the last three left open. Whoever was digging them stopped, and nobody came to fill them.

items.name: Salt rake tally
items.note: A rake handle notched in fives, the notches stopping halfway down. The last mark is cut twice as deep as the rest.

items.name: Child's whistle
items.note: A bone whistle small enough for a child's fingers. It plays one note, the note the benches are tuned to.

items.name: Cantor's breath-stone
items.note: A smooth stone with a hole worn through it by breath. The Choir held these in their teeth to learn to sing without breathing.

items.name: Pilgrim's staff
items.note: A walking staff found hanging below the Viaduct's break, keel up. Its owner's handprints are worn into the top, facing the island.

items.name: Cantor's name-stone
items.note: A name-stone from the crystal cage. The name has been cut out. What's left is the shape of a mouth, open.

items.name: Seat tally
items.note: A slate of counted seats. Two hundred marks, one hundred and ninety-nine crossed through. The last mark is circled.

items.name: The clapper's knot
items.note: A length of rope tied off round a bell's clapper. The knot is a Choir knot: tied so it can't be untied, only cut.

items.name: Choir seat 1 of 200
items.note: A brass seat plate, number one. Polished by use, the way a step is.

items.name: The last note
items.note: A stone that hums when you hold it still. It's the note the Choir stopped on, still sounding.

items.name: Maren's lantern
items.note: The lantern from Maren's bedroll, its glass smoked grey on one side. 12 m of light from a tallow; corruption builds at half while it burns.

items.name: Milk
items.note: Fresh from a farm animal: drink it, or cook with it.

items.name: Head of Vorhollow
items.note: Vorhollow's first-kill trophy: its four jaw-petals closed round the lamprey ring. Mount it at home.

items._forestWorld: The Ancient forest's items from the World track (cooks/biome-forest.md 2.7, 2.19, 2.20, 3.1; cooks/build-biome-forest.md 2.12): materials, the creatures' and bosses' drops, gear, consumables, lore. Every number a first draft.

items.name: Heartwood shavings
items.note: Curls of amber-cored heartwood off an adze. A Burlbeast will follow you for a handful.

items.name: Truffle
items.note: Black, knobbled, smells of earth and old oak. Only a Truffler finds them. Worth a lot in a cook's pot.

items.name: Bootlace rhizomorph
items.note: A black root-lace of honey fungus, tough as rope, its cut ends glowing green. The stuff of the Bootlace blight.

items.name: Foxfire wood
items.note: Rotten wood shot through with glowing mycelium: a cold green light that never goes out.

items.name: Thorns
items.note: Bramble thorns as long as a finger, cut clean from a thornbrake's edge.

items.name: Wasp sting
items.note: A Bramblewasp's stinger, still wet with venom.

items.name: Wasp paper
items.note: Grey chewed-wood paper from a Bramblewasp nest, layered like shale.

items.name: Mossmaul claw
items.note: A hooked claw 35 cm long, horn-black, worn flat on the knuckle side.

items.name: Spotted pelt
items.note: A Thornlynx's grey-gold coat with its dark cloud blotches.

items.name: Lynx fang
items.note: A Thornlynx canine, long as a dagger's blade.

items.name: Rootcoil leather
items.note: Keeled scale-hide that looks like bark: tough, supple, quiet.

items.name: Rootcoil shed
items.note: A shed skin twelve metres long, papery and whole. Works into leather.

items.name: Shed antler
items.note: A palmate antler shed in the shallows of Herne's Ford: bone, and glue boiled from it.

items.name: Bramblewasp larva
items.note: use: hatch a tamed Bramblewasp. A fat white grub eased out of a nest's comb.

items.name: Hiveback brood cell
items.note: use: hatch a tamed Hiveback. A waxed cell taken from a wild hive.

items.name: Grovekin jewellery
items.note: Rings of braided copper and amber beads on cord, worn smooth. Worth a good deal to a trader.

items.name: Verdant essence
items.note: nature path material: sets Nature as an item's element at crafting

items.name: Verdant core
items.note: Sylvaroth boss part: a healing potion you drink heals your tames within 15 m by half as much

items.name: Thornlynx kit
items.note: use: hatch a tamed Thornlynx. A grey-gold kit curled asleep in a nest of old hides, found in the Grey Matron's larder.

items.name: Sylvaroth's head
items.note: The World-Root's burl head, its amber eye hollows still faintly warm. Raise it on a monument at home.

items.name: Blueprint: World-Root Maul
items.note: Sylvaroth's root-mark. Read it to learn the World-Root Maul for good (forge, tier 4).

items.name: World-Root Maul
items.note: A heartwood great hammer bound in living root: always Nature.

items.name: Blueprint: Heartwood longbow
items.note: A Grovekin bowyer's bark scroll. Read it to learn the heartwood longbow for good (workbench, tier 3).

items.name: Heartwood longbow
items.note: Heartwood draws 10% faster and throws 15% further than a hunting bow

items.name: Thorned arrow
items.note: Bramble thorns bound behind the head: +20 bleed per hit

items.name: Bootlace blight
items.note: Thrown (aim the arc): honey-fungus rot in a clay jar. A Root Knot it breaks on dies for 90 s; Old Gnarl's stripped wood can't regrow for 30 s; a tree-bodied beast stops healing for 20 s

items.name: Smoke pot
items.note: Thrown: a 6 m cloud of green smoke for 10 s. Wasps and bees in it go quiet, the scout mark comes off, the Bramblequeen slows

items.name: Briar balm
items.note: Thorn-oil and resin in fat, rubbed on the arms and legs: for 10 minutes thornbrakes bleed you at a third

items.name: Snare stake
items.note: use: set a spring snare where you stand (not in a claim). The first beast up to mount size to step in it is held 3 s, the Hornwarden too. It rots in a game hour

items.name: Foxfire lantern
items.note: Foxfire wood behind amber panes: 8 m of cold green light at the hip that rain can't touch. A day's glow from the wood; more foxfire wood keeps it lit

items.name: Briarproof leathers
items.note: Hide boiled hard and lacquered with resin, every seam double-stitched: walk through thornbrakes unhurt

items.name: Huntsman's crown
items.note: A circlet of antler tines and ivy from the Wild Hunt's leader: your mount's sprint costs 20% less stamina

items.name: Heartwood circlet
items.note: A thin band of heartwood polished by a hand that's long gone, from a table where a family still sits.

items.name: Hermit's ring
items.note: Rowan's own, a ring of oak root with a bead of amber: Growth comes 15% faster and Rooted starts healing 0.5 s sooner

items.name: Sturgeon hook
items.note: A Grovekin bone hook barbed with bronze, kept at their fishing shrine. Grandfather Sturgeon's line breaks on anything less. In your bag: the forest's streams give up their rare fish and their legend more often, and the Sturgeon's line holds.

items.name: Ship's lantern
items.note: Brass, its horn panes cracked, wrapped in sailcloth under a hen-house floor. The ship that carried it is the wreck on the dunes.

items.name: Tally of trees felled
items.note: A board scored in fives. Hundreds of fives. The last line is half cut, and the roots came through the tent that night.

items.name: Antler crown
items.note: Tines of an elk's antler bound in a ring with sinew, from the brow of a hunter in the barrow. Herne wore one like it.

items.name: Bark cradle
items.note: Folded beech bark, sewn with root. Empty. The root it lay on is grown as thick as a thigh.

items.name: Door rune
items.note: A slate cut with a branching mark: the same rune on every lintel in the lane. It means 'we feed the forest'.

items.name: Root-pulse
items.note: A sliver of the Thrumming Root, still warm, still beating slowly against your palm. Four beats, then a rest. Four hearts.

items.name: Last loaf
items.note: A loaf gone to stone on a table where a family sits grown into their chairs, hands joined. They left the bread for the forest, and then they stayed.

items.name: Soulstone dust
items.note: Ground soulstone (a grinder makes four of one). Tombbacks come to it; raised and undead tames want a pinch a day.

items.name: Yew log
items.note: Red-hearted churchyard yew, slow to grow back: the longbow wood, and scythe poles.

items.name: Limestone
items.note: White quarry stone from the Spine's foot and the old quarry below. Burns to quicklime in a kiln (with charcoal).

items.name: Quicklime
items.note: Burnt lime: it eats what it touches. Lime pots, mortar, tanning.

items.name: Grave iron
items.note: Scrap from a broken mortsafe: two of it forge to an iron ingot.

items.name: Silver ore
items.note: Grey ore from the Ossuary's veins, bright where the pick bit.

items.name: Silver ingot
items.note: Rings, lanterns, silvered edges (the Risen and shades fear it).

items.name: Wax
items.note: Wickbeetle wax, pale and clean-burning: candles, lantern seals, waterproofing.

items.name: Gravehound hide
items.note: Thin, supple, almost hairless slate-black hide.

items.name: Cryptstalker carapace
items.note: Chalk-grey plate mottled like the limestone it hunts on: light armour plate.

items.name: Palp spine
items.note: A barbed spine off a Cryptstalker's palp: it goes through the first thing it hits.

items.name: Wraithmoth scale
items.note: Ash-brown dust-scales off a Wraithmoth's wing: an alchemist's stamina tonic.

items.name: Moth silk
items.note: Wraithmoth cocoon silk: fine, strong thread.

items.name: Pale hide
items.note: A Palestrider's ash-white hide.

items.name: Horsehair
items.note: Long black mane hair: bowstrings.

items.name: Beetle shell
items.note: Black-and-rust Tombback shell.

items.name: Goat hair
items.note: Chalk-white Marrowgoat hair: felt.

items.name: Tombback's stone
items.note: The grave slab a Tombback wore, the name on it worn away. Set it in your yard.

items.name: Grave essence
items.note: What a boss of the Graveyard leaves of its grave-light: the Necromancy path's material.

items.name: Paper lantern
items.note: A Mourner's lantern from an empty grave, a name tag tied to its handle.

items.name: Nhal's veiled head
items.note: Nhal's trophy: her head under the moth-veil, the lantern-horns still lit. Mount it at home.

items.name: Mourner's lantern
items.note: Nhal's part. Each kill gives +4% damage for 12 s, stacking to five; a small grave-light lantern floats at your shoulder with a flame per stack.

items.name: The Gravedigger's lantern
items.note: The lantern he hunted by, cracked. Morwen will want to see it.

items.name: Heartwood stake
items.note: Drive it into an open tomb in Nhal's chapel (hold E): roots bind the slab shut and nothing more climbs out. Or pin a fallen Risen to the ground.

items.name: Lime pot
items.note: Thrown: a 4 m splash of quicklime, 20 damage and 8 a second for 3 s. Two on the Ossuary Lord's pile stop it reforming.

items.name: Grave lantern
items.note: Silver and wax-paper round a soulstone: 10 m of pale grave-light, one soulstone burns 4 hours, and no draught or rain puts it out; corruption builds at half while it burns.

items.name: Mourning ring
items.note: Black enamel on silver, a lantern engraved inside: corruption builds 15% slower; +5% necrotic damage.

items.name: Yew longbow
items.note: A churchyard-yew longbow strung with horsehair: arrows hit 15% harder; the draw is a tenth of a second slower.

items.name: Palp-spine arrow
items.note: A barbed Cryptstalker spine on a yew shaft: goes through the first target, +15 bleed buildup.

items.name: Sexton's pick
items.note: The sexton's own pick-hammer from the seventh crypt: silver-tier, and it breaks bone a third harder (the Risen, the Ossuary Lord's keystones).

items.name: Moth-dust tonic
items.note: Wraithmoth scales steeped in water: stamina comes back 15% faster for 5 minutes.

items.name: Asphodel draught
items.note: Asphodel and soulstone: decay builds half as fast on you for 5 minutes.

items.name: Cleansing draught
items.note: Bitter: drink it and corruption falls by 60 at once.

items.name: Mourner's Scythe
items.note: A bell-bronze blade on black yew, its edge rimed with soulstone: always Necromancy.

items.name: Blueprint: Mourner's Scythe
items.note: Nhal's lantern-mark. Read it to learn the Mourner's Scythe for good (forge, tier 4).

items.name: Blueprint: Yew longbow
items.note: From the oldest grave under the Great Yew. Read it to learn the Yew longbow for good (workbench, tier 3).

items.name: The Mourners' chisel
items.note: Left on the step of the Seven Names, beside the blank plate.

items.name: Lantern tag
items.note: A paper tag, a name in an old hand. Folded inside: a second tag, blank.

items.name: Washerwoman's bat
items.note: A washing bat, worn smooth. The grave-clothes beside it were never finished.

items.name: Watcher's tally
items.note: Four hundred and twelve nights scratched in the stone. The last mark is only half a line.

items.name: Ossuary ledger
items.note: Every bone counted and shelved. Hounds, hares, horses, smiths, strangers. One shelf is labelled for the Mourners themselves. It is empty.

items.name: First Lantern
items.note: The oldest lantern in the Graveyard, found in a dog's grave under the yew.

items.name: Bell-founder's tally
items.note: A list of bells cast for the chapel. Beside the last: 'for the day they come down.'

items.name: Bell-founder's mark
items.note: The founder's stamp from inside the drowned bell. It was rung so long it cracked.

items.name: Cloudpine
items.note: Wind-sculpted cedar from the Sky islands: light and strong. Bows of it draw 5% faster; gliders and bridge mends.

items.name: Skysilk
items.note: Gossamer wound off a drift onto a spindle: fine as smoke, strong as wire. Gliders, the Skysilk set, Gale arrows' fletching.

items.name: Levistone core
items.note: The glowing heart of a levistone keel, cut from the Weeping Isle's caves. It tugs upward in the hand.

items.name: Gale essence
items.note: What a boss of the Sky leaves of its wind: the Wind path's material.

items.name: Galeharrier feathers
items.note: Slate flight feathers barred black, tipped teal. Gale arrows.

items.name: Harrier talon
items.note: A black talon 7 cm long.

items.name: Ray leather
items.note: Skyray wing skin: charcoal flecked pale, supple and tough.

items.name: Ray barb
items.note: The serrated barb off a Skyray's tail. Still sharp enough to bleed you.

items.name: Mane hair
items.note: Silver-white Windmane mane hair: bowstrings and fine rope.

items.name: Blubber
items.note: Cloudback fat. Rendered for lamp oil and grease.

items.name: Levistone barnacles
items.note: Glowing barnacles scraped off a Cloudback's hump: levistone grown by a living thing. Ground at the grinder for levistone.

items.name: Shrike claw
items.note: A Gallowshrike's black dagger claw, 12 cm.

items.name: Hush feathers
items.note: Soft, fringed, silent. Hush arrows.

items.name: Hushwing eye
items.note: Amber, the size of a fist. It still shines in torchlight.

items.name: Sail membrane
items.note: Clear-blue Sailbell float with a violet crest: the Sailbell lantern's shade.

items.name: Sting oil
items.note: Wrung from a Sailbell's beads: burns violet and slow (the Sailbell lantern's fuel).

items.name: Kyrra's feathers
items.note: White-tipped flight feathers off the Tempest Harrier, each as long as your arm.

items.name: Worked granite
items.note: White granite dressed by the Kitewrights, off the Bridge Sentinel. Broken at the grinder for stone.

items.name: Aeolith plumes
items.note: Ivory quills tipped jade and gold. Skysilk extra and Gale arrows.

items.name: Chain
items.note: Kitewright lift chain: forged links, every one stamped with a kite.

items.name: Glider spar
items.note: A cloudpine spar off a Kitewright glider.

items.name: Skysilk weave (scrap)
items.note: A teal scarf half-woven on a Kitewright loom. Unpicked at the loom for 3 Skysilk.

items.name: Deepcap spores
items.note: Cyan spores the Flue breathes up from the deep. Spore pots; they weigh a wind-serpent's wings.

items.name: Cloudberry heirloom seeds
items.note: From a Kitewright garden's last bed. Plant 9 in a plot: cloudberries, half as many again.

items.name: Windmane egg
items.note: use: hatch a tamed Windmane. Pale, speckled grey, warm; stolen from a ledge nest the herd guards together.

items.name: Sailbell bud
items.note: use: hatch a tamed Sailbell. A violet bud picked off a bloom's float.

items.name: Gale plume
items.note: Aeolith boss part: an air dash or airborne dodge throws enemies within 4 m back 4 m

items.name: Crude glider
items.note: Spars and stitched hide. Carried, it opens when you jump while falling with 2 m of air under you: 8 m/s forward, 2.6 m/s sink, 5 stamina a second, none in an updraft. 300 s of glide before it needs mending.

items.name: Levistone glider
items.note: Cloudpine, Skysilk panels and floating stones: 11 m/s forward, 2 m/s sink, 3 stamina a second. 900 s of glide.

items.name: Glider mending kit
items.note: use: mends the most worn glider in your bag to full.

items.name: Anchor boots
items.note: Iron-shod, levistone in the heel turned to pull down. Gusts don't move you, nor a Skyray's Undertow or a serpent's lifts.

items.name: Featherdown draught
items.note: Puffwing down steeped with cloudberries: for 10 minutes falls hurt half as much.

items.name: Gale arrow
items.note: Cloudpine, harrier fletching, a levistone tip: flies 10% faster and throws what it hits back 4 m.

items.name: Hush arrow
items.note: Hush-feather fletching: no sound in flight, and what it hits can't tell where it came from. Sneak hits x1.15.

items.name: Kitewright glaive
items.note: A cloudpine haft bound in Skysilk, a bronze blade with a levistone weight: 30% lighter (each swing 10% less stamina) and its running heavy is a leaping cut, 2 m longer from the air.

items.name: Sailbell lantern
items.note: A Sailbell float stretched over a linen frame: 12 m of violet light. Sting oil burns 3 hours, and no gust or Gale puts it out.

items.name: Spore pot
items.note: Thrown: a clay pot of deepcap spores bursts in a 3 m cyan cloud. On a wind-serpent it weighs the feathers (+150 spore buildup).

items.name: Galespine
items.note: Aeolith's spine strung with mane hair: always Wind, every arrow throws its mark back 2.5 m and flies straight a long way.

items.name: Blueprint: Galespine
items.note: Aeolith's feather-mark. Read it to learn Galespine for good (forge, tier 4).

items.name: The Wind Mask of Aeolith
items.note: Aeolith's bone wind-mask, the duck-billed snout plate with its two flared vents: your first kill's. Mount it at home, or make it into its talisman at the armorer.

items.name: Wind Mask talisman
items.note: Momentum builds 20% faster; in a wind over 10 m/s gliding costs no stamina.

items.name: The Kitewright's last kite
items.note: A tiny kite of bone and silk that rose out of the cloud when the bell rang in the turned wind. Gliding costs 20% less stamina.

items.name: A Kitewright bowl
items.note: Nailed to a table that is now the ceiling. Somebody ate here the day the island turned over.

items.name: Kite of the Given
items.note: Two names stitched into one kite, the cloth still knotted round two wrists.

items.name: A bone tube
items.note: Sealed with wax. Inside, a kite rolled tight, in somebody's colours. The Kitewrights sent their dead up on lines.

items.name: The wheelwright's plan
items.note: Twelve vanes, the hub over the Flue, arrows drawn blowing down. In the margin: it will hold until the stone tires.

items.name: A gardener's mask
items.note: Cloth, tied tight, cyan dust in the weave. It didn't help.

items.name: Unfinished kite
items.note: Spars for a sixth kite, no cloth. Five on the wall. A table set for five.

items.name: Serpent anchor rubbing
items.note: Charcoal on silk off the First Kite's anchor: a serpent coiled round a wheel, and a door in a cliff with a jaw for a lintel. Yara Kesh will want this.

items.name: Pearl
items.note: From a giant clam, an oyster or a Pearldiver's paws. A gem: set in a ring it lends Flow (Tide) or breath (anyone); the Coral keep's pearl lamp needs them.

items.name: Sea-glass
items.note: Glass the sea has worn to frost. Reefmail beads, lanterns; with kelp ash it melts down to clear glass.

items.name: Driftwood
items.note: Silver, salt-dry, light. Burns as wood; the Saltkin built their beacons of it.

items.name: Oyster
items.note: Open it raw on the rocks.

items.name: Sea urchin
items.note: Cracked on a stone, the orange roe inside is sweet.

items.name: Tidefowl egg
items.note: Speckled, the size of a fist. From the burrows on the Gullery, or your own Tidefowl.

items.name: Kelp ash
items.note: Black crust from the kelp-burning pits: soda ash, the glassmaker's flux (the real Orkney trade). Iodine for potions.

items.name: Bronze scrap
items.note: Verdigris and bronze scraped off the Pound's bollards. Melt four for a bronze ingot.

items.name: Polished bronze sheet
items.note: A Sunwatch signal mirror's face, cracked across. The Sun mirror's dish needs one.

items.name: Iron nails
items.note: Bronze-headed ship's nails from Saltkin and newcomer timbers. Melt four for an iron ingot.

items.name: Gold leaf
items.note: Beaten Sunwatch gold. Decor, and the Sun mirror's gilding.

items.name: Glass
items.note: Clear glass melted from sea-glass with kelp ash. Diving helms, lanterns, greenhouses.

items.name: Worn harpoon
items.note: A Saltkin harpoon off the Harpooners' Hall rack: ash shaft, bronze toggle head. Thrusts at full speed under water.

items.name: The Sluice key
items.note: An iron key as long as your forearm, taken from the lock of the Drowned Hall's open sluice. Somewhere ashore there is a door under an empty hook.

items.name: Tide-stone rubbing
items.note: Charcoal on linen off a stone on the terraces: a wave carved deep, and under it one line. Below the line on the coast there are only floors.

items.name: Harpooner's tally-cord
items.note: A cord knotted in hundreds, a shark tooth for every tenth. The last knots are tied in a different hand, looser.

items.name: Sunwatch mirror-shard
items.note: Gilt bronze, cracked. On its back a sun with a serpent under it, and the serpent's skin drawn in cracks.

items.name: Votive boat
items.note: A carved boat a hand long with a tiny bronze harpoon in its bow. Someone prayed for a good hunt.

items.name: Bottomless ladle
items.note: A bronze ladle with its bottom knocked out. The drowned ask boats for a ladle to fill them with sea: give them one that holds nothing.

items.name: Broken key-chain
items.note: A fine gold chain from a dead king's neck, snapped at the clasp. Whatever hung on it was pulled, not unhooked.

items.name: Tablet of the Pound
items.note: Clay, tide-marked. A ring wall, four gates, chains; then three suns along the wall's top, their rays crossing on the beast. Under it, how to make a mirror that holds the sun.

items.name: Ship's log, last page
items.note: Water has taken all but one line: 'The towers were lit. We steered for them.'

items.name: Recipe scrap: Whaler's harpoon
items.note: A harpoon drawn on a scrap of hide, a long line coiled at its butt and tied to a stone. Read it to learn the Whaler's harpoon (workbench, level 2).

items.name: Recipe scrap: Glassmaker's pit
items.note: A pit drawn in charcoal, kelp burning in it, sea-glass melting to a clear drop. Read it to learn to make glass (forge).

items.name: Recipe scrap: Tidecoral fittings
items.note: Hull fittings drawn in coral white, with a note: 'cut it living, it sets like stone'. Read it to learn tidecoral fittings for boats (workbench, level 4).

items.name: Recipe: Sun mirror
items.note: How the Sunwatch made a bronze dish that holds the sun and throws it. Read it to learn the Sun mirror (workbench, level 3).

items.name: Glow-moss
items.note: A cushion of cyan moss off a Glow-moss Hall's floor. It keeps glowing in the hand for a day.

items.name: Amadou
items.note: The soft brown flesh of a hoof fungus, beaten flat: the tinder the Iceman carried. Takes a spark from anything.

items.name: Spore sac
items.note: A Puffball's spore sac, still full and soft. Cure it at a workbench to make a puffball sac; burst it and stand back.

items.name: Capling cap
items.note: The cap off a Capling's back. It grows another in a quarter hour and doesn't seem to mind.

items.name: Mite chitin
items.note: A Mycomite's grey back-plate, hard as horn. Ground to a point it goes through hide like a needle.

items.name: Stalker stalk
items.note: One of the white cordyceps stalks off a Sporestalker's crest, its cyan tip still swollen with spores. Worked into a weapon it rots what it cuts a little more (+10% rot).

items.name: Rot-shell
items.note: A plate of a Rotmaw's shell, the cap mound scraped off. Light, ridged, and it doesn't rot: a light shield's plate.

items.name: Fibrous hide
items.note: A Sporestalker's pelt, umber under a fine grey felt of hyphae that won't wash out.

items.name: Toad skin
items.note: Pale pink-white Tunnel toad skin. Oiled, nothing gets through it: water, rot, or spores.

items.name: Shell plate
items.note: A Shroomback's domed scute, olive-brown, a few oyster caps still rooted in its seams.

items.name: Venom sac
items.note: A Webspinner's venom gland. What it holds makes a limb go heavy and slow, then numb.

items.name: Velvet pelt
items.note: A Truffle mole's black velvet: it lies flat whichever way you stroke it.

items.name: Glow gland
items.note: The lantern off a Glowgrub's tail, blue-green, still lit.

items.name: Spore essence
items.note: What a boss of the Fungal caverns leaves of its life: the Spore path's material.

items.name: Queen's jelly
items.note: A cyan jelly from the Sporemother's egg sacs. Eaten by a Spore walker, the sporelings they grow are sturdier for a day (+15% health).

items.name: King's slurry
items.note: The Rot King's crown-drip, rust-red and never dry. Rubbed into a blade's fuller it rots what it cuts (+8 rot a hit).

items.name: Star-thread
items.note: One glowing beaded thread off the Weaver's spinnerets, stronger than gut. A bowstring of it draws 15% faster.

items.name: Mycelorn's core
items.note: The Heart-seed's last ember, amber and still beating, slower each hour: a boss core for the Spore altar's work.

items.name: Hive spore
items.note: Mycelorn's part: a seed of the Hive. What you kill bursts in a 4 m cloud of spores for 4 s (poison 40); you and your party breathe it unharmed. Once every 2 s.

items.name: Hive spore (scarred)
items.note: Mycelorn's part, from a scarred kill: its clouds burst a quarter larger.

items.name: The Heart-seed husk
items.note: Mycelorn's trophy: the Heart-seed's amber husk, the titan's ribs still inside it. Mount it at home (Monument: Mycelorn).

items.name: Filter mask
items.note: Leather over the mouth and nose, two clay cups packed with deepcap ash and charcoal. You walk through spore clouds unhurt. It does nothing for foul air.

items.name: Spore wad
items.note: A wad of spore sac and charcoal held in the cheek: for 5 minutes spore clouds build on you at a third.

items.name: Poison-resist draught
items.note: Deepcap, lion's mane and berries: poison builds at half for 10 minutes.

items.name: Rot-resist draught
items.note: Deepcap, lion's mane and lichen: rot builds at half for 10 minutes.

items.name: Glow-cap lantern
items.note: A deepcap behind a resin window in a copper cage: 12 m of cold cyan light at the hip. Cold: it never flashes a spore cloud and Mycomites don't see it. An hour on a handful of glow-moss.

items.name: Glow paste
items.note: Glow-moss and resin smeared on your blade and helm: 6 m of cold cyan light for 10 minutes. Cold: it flashes nothing.

items.name: Gale flask
items.note: A clay flask round a shard of levistone: it bursts in a 6 m gust for a second, pushing spore clouds 12 m and tearing 12 m of web.

items.name: Amadou tinder
items.note: Amadou beaten and dried: it lights a torch without flint, and the torch it lights burns twice as long.

items.name: Chitin arrow
items.note: A Mycomite's back-plate ground to a needle head: it goes in deeper.

items.name: Knocker idol
items.note: A clay figure with stick eyes from the cairn at the Long Stair: a ceiling about to fall knocks for you a second sooner.

items.name: Farmer's ring
items.note: Ilmari's own, a band of black rhizomorph round a chip of deepcap: Spores come back 20% faster, and poison and rot build on you 15% slower.

items.name: Deepfarmer ring
items.note: Bronze, worn smooth, a ring of tiny caps cast round it. Spores come back 10% faster.

items.name: Effigy of Mycelorn
items.note: Twenty deepcaps bound round a husk of amber resin: offer it at the Heart Wall's stone to wake the Hivemind now.

items.name: Effigy of the Sporemother
items.note: Mite chitin and spore sacs in a clay egg: offer it at the Brood Doline's stone to call the Sporemother.

items.name: Effigy of the Rot King
items.note: A rot-shell plate crowned with black caps: offer it at the Steeping Vats' stone to wake the Rot King.

items.name: Terrace tally
items.note: A notched stick from the Down-Stair Terraces: a notch for every basket brought up. The last row of notches runs the other way.

items.name: Spore print jar
items.note: A sealed jar, a spore print pressed into the lid in five colours. Every jar in the Archive has a name scratched on it. This one has two.

items.name: Titan mould sherd
items.note: A curved piece of fired clay from the Nursery, the inside polished by something that grew against it. The marks on it are from inside.

items.name: Diver's bell
items.note: A little bronze bell from inside the diving bell, its clapper tied with cord so it couldn't ring.

items.name: Kite harness token
items.note: A carved jade token off a war-kite's harness: a kite, and under it a hand closing. The flyer still wore it.

items.name: Champion's kite-token
items.note: Jade, larger, from the champion's fist on the Fall Field. Its kite has no string. It points up the shaft.

items.name: Elder's bowl
items.note: The bronze bowl from the top of the Elders' Tower. Seven mouths drank from it, then climbed. It's clean.

items.name: Heart-seed husk
items.note: A small amber husk from the Seed Vault, a seed of the Heart. It's warm, and it beats if you wait.

items.name: Trade token
items.note: A disc cut half from sunstone and half from a dried deepcap, the two halves pinned together. Someone made a pair of these.

items.name: Raw fish
items.note: Cut from a sea creature. Grill it, salt it, or bait a sea pen.

items.name: Sharkskin
items.note: Rough as a file one way, smooth the other: Reefmail's under-layer, a harpoon's grip.

items.name: Shark tooth
items.note: Serrated, a thumb long. Arrowheads that make wounds bleed.

items.name: Eel skin
items.note: Tough and waterproof: waterskins, swim fins.

items.name: Shock gland
items.note: A Tidecoil's banded organ; it still tingles.

items.name: Wavecharger frond
items.note: A leafy streamer off a Wavecharger; it dries olive-gold.

items.name: Turtle hide
items.note: A Driftback's leathery shell-hide, ridged and oily.

items.name: Ray wing
items.note: A strip of Glowray wing: supple cartilage. Swim fins.

items.name: Photophore gland
items.note: A Glowray's light organ; it glows blue-green for days.

items.name: Pearldiver pelt
items.note: The densest fur in the sea, chocolate with a silver head.

items.name: Blubber
items.note: Rendered for lamp oil and tallow.

items.name: Wavecharger egg
items.note: Taken from a sleeping male's brood pouch. Keep it in salt water (a sea pen or a kelp line) or the incubator; it hatches in 20 minutes.

items.name: Tide essence
items.note: Sea-green and never still in the vial.

items.name: Diver's draught
items.note: Sea grapes, salt and kelp: for 10 minutes you hold your breath 90 s (three times as long).

items.name: Swim fins
items.note: Ray-wing blades on eel-skin straps: you swim a quarter faster; you walk a little slower on land while you wear them.

items.name: Whaler's harpoon
items.note: A Saltkin harpoon on an 18 m line. A hit puts the line on it: small things are hauled in; anything big can be tied off on a mooring stone (E at the stone). You reel it back: it's never lost.

items.name: Beeswax plugs
items.note: Wax in your ears: the Siren Eel's song can't lure you and a Gullraider's mob call doesn't carry to you. Everything high and thin goes quiet.

items.name: Sunstone flare
items.note: Thrown (never homing): a 2 m burst of daylight where it lands. Blinds (25). On the Tide Leviathan it's a second of the sun's beam on the part it hits.

items.name: Shark-tooth arrow
items.note: Bleed 20 a hit; a tenth harder on anything swimming.

items.name: Eel-skin waterskin
items.note: Tidecoil skin keeps more water sweet than a plain skin (60).

items.name: Pearl ring
items.note: A pearl set in a plain band: 3% more Flow for the Tide path, or 5 s more breath for anyone.

items.name: Pearl circlet
items.note: The sluice-keeper's wife's circlet: 10 s more breath, and soak builds a little slower on you.

items.name: Hae-won's knife
items.note: Her dive knife with a tidecoral edge: soak 20 a hit, and it swings at full speed under the water in anyone's hand.

items.name: Diving helm
items.note: Copper and tidecoral round a glass port: twice the breath and no crushing depth to 40 m.

items.name: Harpoon head
items.note: A Saltkin harpoon head, toggled bronze. Whaler's harpoons are made round one.

items.name: Gold coin
items.note: Old coin. Traders take it.

items.name: Sun disc
items.note: A Saltkin bronze sun disc, polished: hang it at home (decor).

items.name: Ambergris
items.note: Grey, waxy, sweet-smelling: washed up after a squall. Alchemists and traders pay well for it.

items.name: Thalassor's core
items.note: The Tide Leviathan's heart-stone, still cold and wet: the Tide path's boss core.

items.name: Leviathan pearl
items.note: A pearl the size of a fist from Thalassor's gut. A dodge or kick-dodge in the water gives you back 10 stamina (once a second).

items.name: Thalassor's head
items.note: The Tide Leviathan's ram of a head: a monument for your base.

items.name: Blueprint: Tidebreaker
items.note: A spear-class harpoon on a chain (its moveset comes with the boss weapons).

items.name: Blueprint: Coral keep decor
items.note: The Coral keep's dressing: coral sconces, shell curtains, a pearl-inlay table.
